MAGNUS.title: The legacy of Magnus
MAGNUS.intro: Four heirs discover Magnus’s stones and the secrets of Freljord.
MAGNUS.replaceWarning: Existing campaign documents, including notes and changes, will be replaced. Back up your world before continuing. Other documents are preserved.
MAGNUS.notImported: Campaign not imported into this world.
MAGNUS.updateNotice: Import preserves existing documents. Module updates never automatically change your world.
MAGNUS.phaseWarning: The selected token will use the chosen phase’s actor and current HP. The GM decides when the transition occurs.
MAGNUS.stoneWarning: Consult the GM description and apply the destiny loss specified in the scenario. This helper records contact; secret visions remain private.
MAGNUS.timelineWarning: Prepare the coronation meal for day 3 or 4. The GM controls triggers and consequences.
MAGNUS.gasWarning: Confirm a closed room or Anti-mirror Chamber. Source rate: 2 HP/min, doubling every 5 minutes. Room size and the roll may alter this rate; adjust when appropriate. Stop gas before advancing travel time.
